scope: Same frozen c779 executable and four raw inputs as failed train40 case; only existing IMU-supported long-gap selector added. No threshold tuning or truth-based selection.
limitations: This is a failure-recovery experiment; the failed baseline has no accuracy score.

This existing train route is development data, not heldout.
